title: Multichannel, ultra-wideband Rydberg electrometry with an optical frequency comb
abstract: Uses a mid-infrared frequency-agile optical frequency comb as the coupling laser for three-photon Rydberg atom electrometry. Enables rapid switching between up to seven individual Rydberg states, providing multichannel detection from 1 GHz to 40 GHz simultaneously. Published in Nature Communications 2025.
key_claims: Seven simultaneous Rydberg channels from 1-40 GHz
Mid-infrared frequency comb enables rapid Rydberg state switching
Addresses bandwidth limitation of single-state EIT approaches
Simultaneous multi-frequency reception with single vapor cell
hardware_used: Rb vapor cell with mid-IR frequency comb coupling laser
